code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,4))
ax.plot([-10,10],[8,8],'k-',lw=2)
ax.annotate('object', xy=(0,8.5))
# dome skin
import numpy as np
x=np.linspace(-9,9,100)
dome=4+3*np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,1-(x/10)**2))
ax.plot(x,dome,'k-',lw=2)
ax.fill_between(x, dome-1.5, dome, alpha=0.2)
ax.text(0,5.5,'silicone skin 1.5mm Shore A10')
ax.fill_between(x, dome-3.5, dome-1.5, alpha=0.15)
ax.text(0,3.0,'gel interlayer 2mm')
ax.plot(x, np.ones_like(x)*0.5,'k-',lw=3)
ax.text(0,0.0,'rigid core + nail (fixed)')
ax.annotate('ridges 0.4mm pitch', xy=(4,6.2), xytext=(5,7.5), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'))
ax.annotate('1mN -> 0.47mm dia spot', xy=(0,4.5), xytext=(-8,2.0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'))
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png', dpi=150)
